title: Sumbangan Keperluan Asas Sarawak (SKAS) 2026
paragraphs: For an Anak Sarawak with identity-card status K who lives in Sarawak.
You are included automatically from Sumbangan Tunai Rahmah (STR) 2026. There is no new application.
A household with income of RM5,000 or below.
A single adult aged 21 to 59, or a single person with a disability aged 19 to 59, with income of RM2,500 or below.
A senior aged 60 or older, without a spouse or eligible children, with income of RM5,000 or below.
Activate S Pay Global and acknowledge the claim before mid-December 2026. The next payment is 10 November 2026.
Paid through S Pay Global for essential food.

title: Domestic Electricity Discount
amounts: 25% for domestic users, April to December 2026
paragraphs: Sarawak Energy domestic customer on Tariff D. Not for commercial use.
Discount on April–December 2026 usage, applied on the bill. No application.
Bill corrections: contact Sarawak Energy by 28 February 2027.

title: Bantuan Kewangan Khas (BKK) for IPT Students
paragraphs: Diploma or first-degree student at IPTA or IPTS. No income cap.
Paid twice a year through S Pay Global.

title: Free Laptop
unspecified: A laptop is given in kind. The page does not state a cash amount.
paragraphs: For a first-year diploma or bachelor student. Family income per person must be RM1,500 or below.

title: Book Voucher
paragraphs: Book aid for an IPT student.
Foundation through PhD. No income cap.

title: Inisiatif Graduan Pulang Sarawak (IGPS)
paragraphs: Flight subsidy home to Sarawak for a full-time student aged 18+ studying outside Sarawak. At least one Sarawakian parent.
Apply online to Yayasan Sarawak. Open all year.
Claim within 60 days of the flight.

title: Geran Kemasukan IPT
paragraphs: First semester of certificate, matriculation, foundation, pre-diploma, diploma or bachelor. At least one Sarawakian parent.
Family income per person RM1,500 or below.
Apply online to Yayasan Sarawak. Open all year.

title: Selected-Course Tuition Waiver at Four Institutions
amounts: RM15,000 a year, only if income per person is RM1,500 or below
paragraphs: Tuition waiver for selected courses at Swinburne, Curtin, UTS and i-CATS.
No separate application. The university forwards names.
Stipend: RM5,000 lodging and RM10,000 through S Pay Global.

title: HDAS Deposit Assistance
amounts: Deposit of 10%, or a maximum of RM10,000
paragraphs: First-home deposit for a B40 or M40 buyer. Registered developer home or build on SPK or SPS land.
Apply through Mutiara on 082-313035.

title: SRAS Rent Assistance
paragraphs: IPTA or IPTS student renting in Kuching, Samarahan, Sibu, Bintulu or Miri.
Also covers a PPR tenant with status K and income RM4,556 or below.
Apply online.

title: Rumah Spektra Permata
paragraphs: Affordable home for a married applicant or single parent aged 18 to 65 without an existing house or land.
Financing through Mutiara Mortgage & Credit.
Amounts above are price and income band, not a cash grant.

title: Sri Pertiwi
unspecified: This is an affordable house, not a cash payment. Selling-price caps are not listed here.
paragraphs: Household income up to RM10,000.

title: Senior Citizen Health Benefit (SCHB)
amounts: Up to RM500 a person a year
paragraphs: Status K, aged 60+, household income RM7,000 or below, no other outpatient cover.
Apply online on Service Sarawak.
Cashless outpatient treatment at panel clinics.

title: Kenyalang Gold Card (KGC)
paragraphs: Participating merchants give discounts.
Status K, aged 60+, living in Sarawak. Included automatically.
Activate online. Virtual card is in SarawakPass.

title: Bantuan Ihsan Kematian (BIK)
amounts: RM1,800 to the next of kin
paragraphs: Registered next of kin of a Kenyalang Gold Card holder who has died.
No JPA death benefit and not living in a government institution.
Apply on Service Sarawak within 4 months of the death.

title: Bantuan Ibu Bersalin (BIB)
paragraphs: Malaysian mother with status K, or wife of a Malaysian with status K. Birth in or outside Sarawak. At least 22 weeks gestation.
Apply within 3 months on iSarawakCare. Needs SarawakPass and S Pay Global.

title: Endowment Fund Sarawak (EFS)
paragraphs: Birth or adopted child. Parent Malaysian with status K. Child born in or outside Sarawak.
Apply on Service Sarawak within 1 year. Withdraw at 18 with MyKad at the bank.
Child born overseas without MyKid: manual form to efs@sarawak.gov.my.

title: Bantuan Ketua Isi Rumah Wanita (KIRWaS)
paragraphs: Sarawakian woman 18+ with status K (or wife of status K). Single mother or female head of household, not on welfare aid.
Service Sarawak: household income RM1,169 to RM4,849. Apply on iSarawakCare or submit to JWKS.
JWKS: woman in business, household income RM2,618 or below. Apply through JWKS.
Service Sarawak and JWKS both state RM1,000. Income tests differ — use the page you apply on.

title: Sarawak Micro Credit Scheme (SMCS)
paragraphs: Sarawakian business operating in Sarawak at least 6 months. Working capital, premises, or machinery.
Apply online, or at SEDC or Agrobank.
Type 1 is for B40 borrowers. Agriculture is excluded.

title: Geran Pelancaran / Modal Mikro
paragraphs: JKMS client who can still work, income at or below the poverty line.
One-off startup capital. Apply on iSarawakCare or at a JKMS office.

title: Bantuan Am (BA)
paragraphs: State welfare aid. Apply at a JKMS office.

title: Bantuan Belia-Beliawanis (BBB)
paragraphs: State aid for youth. Apply at a JKMS office.
